🆕 Newly Posted (Published: August 26, 2026)

Hanno City is now recruiting community-based care service providers for facility development planned within fiscal year 2027 (Reiwa 9). This recruitment is based on Hanno City's Long-term Care Insurance Business Plan, 9th Period (fiscal years 2024–2026 / Reiwa 6–8), and aims to ensure and improve service quality while conducting fair selection. Applicants should review the "Hanno City Community-Based Care Service Provider Recruitment Guidelines." The recruitment guidelines, application document checklist, and application forms (in Excel format) are available for download.

Source (Japanese): https://www.city.hanno.lg.jp/soshikikarasagasu/kenkohukusibu/kaigofukushika/ninteikyufu/10415.html
